description: IRVE STATIC is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mathieu Bourlioux. Fichier listant les stations de recharge pour véhicules électriques disponibles dans les magasins Aldi: adresses, puissances, types de prises et horaires d'accès pour faciliter la recharge. Coverage: Mathieu Bourlioux. The publisher named on the listing is Mathieu Bourlioux. Its keywords include borne-de-recharge, borne-de-recharge-vehicule-electrique, borne-de-rechargement-electrique. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-05-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
